hero.title: Complete financial management
hero.subtitle: Finset is a SaaS software designed for professional clubs, providing a unique platform for centralising and steering financial flows, transforming operational complexity into clear, controlled decisions.

features.title: Core features
features.subtitle: Centralise all your sports financial operations in a single intelligent solution, fully compliant with FIFA and UEFA regulations.

squadManagement.title: Squad tracking
squadManagement.description: Visualise your current and historical squad, access detailed player profiles, and compare wage structures.

network.title: Financial oversight
network.description: Dashboards centralising financial flow visualisation and tracking of the club's financial evolution.

transferManagement.title: Transfer management
transferManagement.description: Centralise all club transfers with visibility over payment schedules and financial impact.

contracts.title: Contract management
contracts.description: Centralise contracts and documents, calculate performance-based variable compensation, and simulate the financial impact of new contracts.

forecast.title: Simulation & forecasting
forecast.description: Simulation tool for P&L line-item forecasting, with automatic report generation for submission to the regulator.

compensations.title: Compensation management
compensations.description: Automated calculation and tracking of training and solidarity fees under FIFA regulations, with alert notifications.

footer.description: The complete financial management SaaS for professional football clubs.

legal.title: Terms of Service & Privacy Policy
legal.intro: Finset is a SaaS platform dedicated to the financial management of professional football clubs. This page describes our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
legal.contactCta: To exercise your rights or for any question regarding your data, contact us.

sections.title: 1. Service Description
items: Finset is a SaaS platform dedicated to the financial management of professional football clubs.
Access is provided through a secure web application, with access control based on user profiles.

sections.title: 2. Data Hosting & Infrastructure
items: The application is hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS).
The architecture relies on two levels of data isolation: one dedicated database instance per country, and within each instance, an isolated space per club.
Data is stored in the country of residence of the club, in accordance with the data sovereignty principle.
AWS acts as a sub-processor subject to GDPR Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs).

sections.title: 3. Use of Artificial Intelligence
items: Finset uses the Anthropic Claude API for AI-powered extraction of player and contract data from uploaded PDF files.
When a PDF is processed, its content is temporarily transmitted to Anthropic. This transfer is covered by Anthropic's DPA and EU Standard Contractual Clauses.
Data sent to Anthropic is used solely for extraction purposes and is never used to train AI models.
API logs are retained by Anthropic for a maximum of 7 days before automatic deletion.
Users are informed before uploading any file containing personal data.

sections.title: 4. Data Controller & Sub-processors
items: Finset acts as a data processor on behalf of the club, which is the data controller.
AWS: infrastructure and database hosting.
Anthropic PBC: AI processing for the contract import feature.
Auth0 (Okta): user identity and authentication management.

sections.title: 5. Personal Data Processed
items: Player identity data (name, date of birth, nationality).
Contract data (salary, bonuses, contract duration, clauses).
User account data (club administrators and staff).
Usage logs for security and audit purposes.

sections.title: 6. Your Rights (GDPR)
items: In accordance with the GDPR, you have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection regarding your personal data.
Every request receives a response within 30 days.

sections.title: 7. Data Retention
items: Active contract data is retained for the duration of the subscription, plus the applicable legal archiving period.
Data is purged within 30 days of a deletion request or account termination.
Anthropic API logs are retained for a maximum of 7 days, managed by Anthropic.

sections.title: 8. Security
items: Data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+).
Access to the platform is controlled based on user profiles.
Security audits are carried out regularly.
